bugs.title: Live Binance + Polymarket API integration has not been verified end-to-end
bugs.description: Unit tests pass, but the build environment could not perform live network calls. The morning pipeline must complete against the real public APIs before PAPER 20 starts.
bugs.evidence: Known build limitation documented in README.md
bugs.next_action: Run LIVE-DATA-001 health test against Binance klines, Polymarket Gamma and Polymarket CLOB; capture raw responses and verify parsers.

bugs.title: Daily Polymarket resolution rule is configured but not automatically verified against the market rules text
bugs.description: The pipeline currently relies on configured resolution timezone/time. Before a scored forecast, the exact source, symbol, candle, time and boundary convention must match that day's market rules.
bugs.evidence: README limitation: exact resolution rule must remain market-specific
bugs.next_action: Add a rules snapshot/verification step and refuse scoring when rule verification is not PASS.

bugs.title: Europe/Sofia ↔ America/New_York DST edge cases need integration tests
bugs.description: The implementation uses IANA time zones, but the periods when US and EU daylight-saving transitions differ need explicit tests to prevent one-hour resolution errors.
bugs.evidence: Time conversion is critical to lock and resolution timestamps
bugs.next_action: Add DST test vectors for spring/fall transition windows and verify exact UTC candle timestamps.

bugs.title: Hit-price forecasts are generated but hit-price scoring is not yet persisted
bugs.description: BUILD-001 can estimate hit probabilities, but score.json currently focuses on daily range scoring.
bugs.next_action: Implement high/low-based hit resolution and Brier scoring before HIT PAPER tests are counted.

bugs.title: Gemini context failure path needs a recorded fallback test
bugs.description: Gemini is non-authoritative for the numerical forecast, but the system should prove that API errors degrade to VERIFY/UNKNOWN without breaking the forecast pipeline.
bugs.evidence: Pipeline records Gemini status but fallback has not been live-tested
bugs.next_action: Run with missing/invalid GEMINI_API_KEY and a simulated HTTP failure; confirm deterministic safe degradation.

bugs.title: GitHub Pages observability deployment not yet verified
bugs.description: The HTML renderer exists locally, but the public Pages deployment and latest-status view have not been tested.
bugs.evidence: Repository has not yet been created/deployed
bugs.next_action: Publish docs/ via GitHub Pages and confirm the current forecast, benchmark, resolution, score and QA status are visible.
